outcome_variable_scope: A partition of r58's stored UNVERIFIED rows by resolvability. No measurement, no model, no new data -- the cost axis is read from each round's source, the estimand axis from its estimator where that has been read.
scope: The COST axis is decidable from the source and is complete. The ESTIMAND axis is not mechanically decidable and has been read for r87 and r96 only, so 'candidate_cpu' is an UPPER BOUND on recoverable contrasts, never a work queue. A candidate whose estimand turns out pooled joins the structural class and no compute would have helped it.
verdict: M MIXED. r58 reports 27 UNVERIFIED contrasts under one label, which invites reading it as 27 pieces of outstanding work. It is not. Partitioned by what resolving each would COST: 6 are STRUCTURAL -- r87's and r96's estimands are pooled ratios of prompt-means, and a nonlinear function of aggregates has no per-unit paired vector, so no amount of persistence or compute resolves them and r58's TOST cannot consume them in principle. 3 need a MODEL LOADED to replay, and a further 2 need one AND sit behind a freeze (r20: more paraphrase sweeps are frozen). The remaining 16 are CANDIDATES for a CPU replay of the r97 kind -- inputs on disk, no model, seconds of compute. THE WORD 'CANDIDATE' IS DOING WORK AND IS NOT A HEDGE: cheap-to-replay says NOTHING about whether the estimand is a mean of paired units, and the two rounds proven structural are BOTH pure CPU -- exactly the pair a cost-only reading would have mislabelled as recoverable. Estimand type has been READ for 2 rounds and is UNVERIFIED for the rest, so the candidate count is an upper bound on recoverable work and not a work queue. PARTITION CONTROL: 27 rows classified against 27 UNVERIFIED, all distinct; the round refuses to run if the classes overlap or leak, because a triage that is not a partition cannot be quoted. WHAT THIS CHANGES: 'UNVERIFIED: 27' should never again be quoted as a backlog figure. At most 16 of it is actionable without a model, at least 6 of it is not actionable at all, and the difference is invisible in the census's own label.
